description: Who is this vehicle manufacturer and where are they registered? Returns NHTSA registration details for manufacturers matching a name or manufacturer ID: legal and common name, trading names, address and country, manufacturer type (for example completed vehicle manufacturer, vehicle alterer, importer), vehicle types and weight classes, named principal and last update. For supplier research, KYB and procurement checks. Source: NHTSA vPIC. Name matching is partial, so expect related firms such as dealers; personal contact emails are left out. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, max manufacturers to return, 1-50, default 10

manufacturer.description: string, required, manufacturer name (partial match, e.g. honda) or NHTSA manufacturer ID (e.g. 988)

name: vehicle_manufacturer_details
